title: Harden remux and encode validation gates
summary: Implements verified findings from the FFmpeg remux/encode command-generation and stream-mapping review where safe in a scoped batch, with remaining full-manifest validation explicitly tracked.
reason: The review identified paths where primary-video-only routing, warning-success muxing, fail-open verification, and CPU fallback concurrency could publish or trust media that was not fully vetted. These areas touch FFmpeg command generation, audio routing, output verification, and publish safety boundaries.
behavior_before: Primary-only video facts could lead remux/encode commands that map all real video streams; remux could continue after risky mkvmerge warning text or ambiguous audio default-track TID probing; strict/fallback size guard inspection failures returned Ok=true; block_review quality verification still fail-opened on tool/probe errors; CPU fallback could proceed after a timed mutex wait without confirming acquisition.
behavior_after: The pipeline fails closed on multi-real-video inputs until per-stream routing/output validation exists; risky mkvmerge warnings, ambiguous remux audio TID mapping, strict/fallback size-guard inspection failures, block_review quality verifier errors, and failed CPU mutex acquisition block processing before publish.
tests_added: ops/pipeline/tests/Unit/Invoke-FFmpegProgressChecks.ps1: benign versus blocking mkvmerge warning classification
ops/pipeline/tests/Unit/Invoke-QualityVerificationChecks.ps1: block_review quality verifier errors block publish
ops/pipeline/tests/Unit/Invoke-EncodeFlagPolicyChecks.ps1: CPU fallback mutex timeout blocks encode
ops/pipeline/tests/Unit/Invoke-FailureCodeRegistryChecks.ps1: new emitted outcome codes are registered
ops/pipeline/tests/Invoke-WebViewReliabilityChecks.ps1: static reliability contracts for mkvmerge warning handling and failure-code registry
manual_validation: Read AGENTS.md, docs/CURRENT_PROJECT_STATE.md, docs/OPEN_WORK_CHECKLIST.md, docs/generated/PROJECT_INDEX.md, and docs/operator/NO_TOUCH_BOUNDARY_REGISTER.md before source edits.
Ingested 00-review-scope.md through 08-final-review-summary.md from an external review workspace.
Verified all eight deduplicated findings against the current dirty source checkout before edits.

Focused PowerShell 7 tests passed: Invoke-MediaVerificationSafetyChecks.ps1, Invoke-FFmpegProgressChecks.ps1, Invoke-EncodeSizeGuardInspectionChecks.ps1, Invoke-QualityVerificationChecks.ps1, Invoke-EncodeFlagPolicyChecks.ps1, Invoke-FailureCodeRegistryChecks.ps1.
Adjacent PowerShell 7 tests passed: Invoke-AudioPolicyChecks.ps1, Invoke-PipelinePlanExecutorChecks.ps1, Invoke-ToolIntegrationChecks.ps1.
Generated summaries refreshed for touched source, tests, and this change packet.

Full real-media validation remains operator-run because this environment did not provide a media corpus covering multi-video, risky mkvmerge warnings, ambiguous audio TID probing, strict/fallback size guard inspection failures, quality-verifier tool failures, and MP4 compatibility exclusions.
rollback_plan: Revert only the files listed in files_touched plus generated summaries from this packet. Do not revert unrelated dirty worktree files, operator review artifacts, source media, runtime state, personal config, release packages, or archived rollback evidence.

implementation_ledger.risk_boundary_touched: FFmpeg command generation and stream mapping

required_tests: real-media validation after media behavior changes
implementation_ledger.risk_boundary_touched: Production publish validation and real-media trust
implementation_ledger.blocked_reason: A generalized expected-stream manifest must define per-container expected outputs for audio, subtitle, attachment, and intentional exclusion evidence before it can safely become a publish gate.
implementation_ledger.safe_next_step: Design the expected-stream manifest contract and validate it against a real-media matrix before enforcing it at publish.

implementation_ledger.blocked_reason: MP4 compatibility intentionally excludes unsupported streams, so enforcing stream-count parity without a manifest would break valid policy. The missing requirement is explicit publish evidence for intentional exclusions.
implementation_ledger.safe_next_step: Add manifest evidence for expected drops/preserves per container, then run MP4 real-media validation before making it a blocking publish gate.

notes: High-validation media-policy change. Full generalized expected-stream manifest validation, including MP4 intentional exclusions and subtitle/attachment evidence, is tracked as blocked for separate design plus real-media validation; this packet implements fail-closed guards for the highest silent-publish paths that can be made safe in a focused batch.
